{{samename|[[Mega Evolution]] Trainer in [[Pokémon the Series]]|Mabel}} {{Character Infobox |color=eb8b51 |bordercolor=ab3f26 |corecolor={{water color light}} |name=Mable |jname=モミジ |tmname=Momiji |image=ZA Mable.png |size=200px |caption=Art from [[Pokémon Legends: Z-A|Legends: Z-A]] |gender=Female |eyes=Blue |hair=Blue |hometown=[[Lumiose City]] (original hometown unknown) |region=[[Kalos]] |relatives=Unknown }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{water color light}} |gen={{gen|VI}}, {{gen|IX}} |games={{pkmn|X and Y|X, Y}}, {{pkmn|Legends: Z-A}} |trainer={{tc|Team Flare}} }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{water color light}} |member=[[Team Flare]] |rank=Scientist }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{water color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' |debut=''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]'' |enva=[[Laurie Hymes]] |jpva=[[Sayuri Hara]] }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{water color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |debut=''[[PS550|X-actly What They Wanted]]'' }} |} '''Mable''' (Japanese: '''モミジ''' ''Momiji'') is a recurring character found in {{g|X and Y}} and their sequel, {{g|Legends: Z-A}}. In X and Y, she is one of [[Team Flare]]'s five {{tc|Team Flare|scientists}}. She is the only one of the five to reappear in Legends: Z-A, where she is the acting director of the {{kal|Pokémon Research Lab}} in [[Lumiose City]], conducting research on the Pokémon found in the [[wild zone]]s of Lumiose City and their growing numbers.[https://legends.pokemon.com/en-us/story-world/characters Pokémon Legends: Z-A official website] In X and Y, she is noted to be investigating different types of energy, with Legends: Z-A making it clear that she was specifically researching Pokémon life energy."''I’d been researching Pokémon’s life energy for ages, and I was still overwhelmed by that feeling.''" - Mable ([[Pokémon Legends: Z-A]]) ==In the core series games== === [[Pokémon X and Y]] === Mable is one of five [[Team Flare]] scientists that are the driving force behind the team, being distinguishable with her blue hair, blue lipstick, and her prominent visor. She is first seen in the [[Frost Cavern]] agitating an {{p|Abomasnow}} with two {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s. With [[Trevor]] helping the {{player}} in defeating the Grunts, the player then defeats Mable and forces her to retreat. She is met again at [[Lysandre Labs]], preparing for Team Flare's plan to use the [[ultimate weapon]]. Upon being defeated again, she hands the player the [[Elevator Key]] required to access the lower floors of the facility. === [[Pokémon Legends: Z-A]] === {{main|Mable's research}} By helping complete her research requests, the player can earn [[TM]]s and other rewards. ====Base game==== After the events of Pokémon X and Y, Mable was taken into custody along with the rest of Team Flare. However, she was offered a plea deal and appointed as the acting director of the {{kal|Pokémon Research Lab}} so the government can keep a close eye on her, effectively replacing [[Professor Sycamore]] following his resignation as the previous director some time before the events of Legends: Z-A. Mable also mentions that she is not allowed to leave [[Lumiose City]] or travel freely within it. Her dialogue while giving the player their Kanto First Partner Pokémon also implies she was given some instruction by Professor Sycamore. At the start of the game, due to the sudden increase in Pokémon since the beginning of the urban redevelopment plan, she is researching the habits of these new Pokémon and the reason for their sudden surge in population. She seeks the {{player}}'s help in her investigation to offset her large workload by filling in the [[List of Pokémon by Lumiose Pokédex number|Lumiose Pokédex]] and Mega Evolution Pokédex. Mable makes an important role later in the game. In attempts to uncover who [[Grisham|Gris]] is so that the {{player}} can battle him in the [[Z-A Royale]], they make their way to Mable's office after hearing connections to [[Team Flare]]. Mable reaffirms the suspicions, Gris, whose real name is ''Grisham'' was a former member of Team Flare, raised as a part of a "new generation" for the organization. She initially tries to deflect the question, but at the players insistence she eventually provides information on the man, leading [[Team MZ]] to the [[Team Flare Nouveau]] truck at [[Centrico Plaza]]. In the post game, Mable also provides a supporting role. Upon completing [[Mission (Legends: Z-A)|Mission 38: "The Future of Lumiose City"]] and returning to [[Hotel Z]], the player learns about "the one who gives" and "the one who takes" from [[Lysandre|L]], the former head of Team Flare. To gather some clues, they pay a visit to Mable, who is yelling about the occurrence of more wild zones. Upon asking, Mable provides information on Lysandre's previous goals with Team Flare. A Pokémon who gives life: {{p|Xerneas}} and a Pokémon who takes it: {{p|Yveltal}}. Upon heavy research, the intense amounts of [[Mega Power]] has caused wild Pokémon to travel closer and closer to [[Lumiose City]], including the [[Legendary Pokémon]] of [[Kalos]]. After being tasked to take down three [[alpha Pokémon]] in the various Wild Zones, she tasks the player in stopping the two legendary Pokémon by catching them, as they could pose a threat to the people living in the city. As the player takes on these missions, Mable provides historical context with Xerneas and Yveltal and Team Flare, claiming that they had taken out numerous of their own Grunts. She then thanks the player for their help in calming Xerneas, stating that at least now it felt like all her research for Team Flare hadn't been for nothing. ====[[Mega Dimension]]==== Like many of the characters, Mable reappears during the events of the Mega Dimension DLC. Her first appearance is after [[Team MZ]] makes it out of [[Hyperspace Lumiose]] for the first time, appearing via [[Holo Caster]] excited about the discoveries in Lumiose. She then provides the {{player}} with new research tasks and a new Pokédex, the [[List of Pokémon by Hyperspace Pokédex number|Hyperspace Pokédex]]. This extra research may go into base game rewards. While the player may visit her during the main story of the DLC, she only makes a few minimal appearances, notably getting transported to hyperspace along with the rest of the cast, whereupon she comments on how she would prefer not to lose her own life when sent into hyperspace despite her curiosity towards it. She eventually takes a larger role in the DLC's post game, assisting [[Corbeau]] and the [[Rust Syndicate]] in research of hyperspace once the player has defeated both {{p|Kyogre}} and {{p|Groudon}}, explaining how {{p|Darkrai}}'s nightmare-related powers mixed with the [[Mega Power]] leaking from the remains of [[Ange]], resulting in the existence of Hyperspace Lumiose. Mable further explains that this resulted in a manifestations created by a subconscious of dreams and wishes, having both Pokémon and appear from within. Corbeau dismissively thanks Mable for her explanation, asking her what [[Ansha]] could do to summon {{p|Rayquaza}}. Mable proceeds with an overtly scientific answer that Ansha would have to "wish really hard". After a squabble she disappears from the room, with hopes that Ansha may succeed. ====Side missions==== Mable appears in three {{DL|Mission (Legends: Z-A)|side missions}}: Side Mission 22: "A Call from Mable", Side Mission EX2: "Project M", and Side Mission 194: "Volcanion Unleashed!". In "A Call from Mable", Mable will request for the player to come to her office at the Research Lab. Upon entry, she will aggressively yell at her computer about the existence of Wild Zones, like she has prior. On behalf of the previous director, she then asks of the player to make a choice between three Pokémon; {{p|Bulbasaur}}, {{p|Charmander}} or {{p|Squirtle}}, just like Professor Sycamore had during the events of X and Y. In "Project M", the player will reach down into the basement of [[Lysandre Labs]] holding both [[Mewtwonite X]] and [[Mewtwonite Y]] stones, awakening {{p|Mewtwo}}. This alerts Mable, forgetting that Mewtwo was found there in the first place, and that Mewtwo must be caught at all costs. Upon success, Mable appears using her Holo Caster. The five Team Flare scientists were originally tasked in catching Mewtwo, the same one found in the {{kal|Unknown Dungeon}}. As it had the capabilities to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]], they had hoped that it could be used in case their plans with either {{p|Xerneas}} and {{p|Yveltal}} have gone awry. Mewtwo was eventually forgotten about, and was not needed, being left in the Lysandre Labs. In "Volcanion Unleashed", Mable will request the player's help with a hacked Poké Ball containing the [[Mythical Pokémon]] {{p|Volcanion}}, admitting Team Flare previously researched Poké Ball hacking and that she found it distasteful, then stating that she had to use drastic measures to free Volcanion that have almost certainly angered it. She then calls in [[Yvon]] from the [[Lumiose Press]], who had used her sources to do some research on Volcanion. After the player calms and catches Volcanion, she will again thank them and admit she somewhat sympathizes with the Pokémon, as they both lost their freedom as a result of Team Flare's misdeeds. {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Mable anime.png|thumb|250px|Mable in {{aniseries|XY}}]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== In the past, Mable, alongside [[Lysandre]] and the other [[Team Flare]] Scientists, would help those in need, until Lysandre became disillusioned with the [[human]] race and sought to restart the world. Mable debuted in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]''. She was first seen leading a group of {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s in [[Terminus Cave]], where they attempted to capture {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|50%}} {{p|Zygarde}}. However, all of their Pokémon's combined attacks didn't even phase the [[Legendary Pokémon]], which used {{m|Land's Wrath}} on the [[villainous team]] members before disappearing. Mable was later seen informing Lysandre and [[Xerosic]] of the failure of her mission. Mable briefly appeared in ''[[XY102|Meeting at Terminus Cave!]]'' in a video call with Xerosic, where she and [[Aliana]] were ordered to head to [[Z2]] after Team Flare discovered its location thanks to their sensors. [[File:Team Flare Scientists Young.png|thumb|left|250px|A younger Mable (far left)]] In ''[[XY107|An Explosive Operation!]]'', she, Aliana, and several Team Flare Grunts were trying to capture Z2. She managed to hit Z2 with a beam from her specialized gun, preventing Z2 from camouflaging itself. When she and Aliana ordered their Pokémon, {{p|Weavile}} and {{p|Druddigon}}, to attack Z2, it transformed into its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|10% Forme}} and used its powerful attacks to defeat Team Flare and managed to escape. She and Aliana caught up to it, only to face {{TRT}}, who wanted Z2 for themselves. Due to Team Rocket's intervention, Z2 managed to escape once again. Team Flare, however, quickly found them and a battle between both teams took place. After a prolonged struggle, Team Flare emerged victorious and managed to corner Z2. This, however, triggered Z2 to transform to its 50% Forme and it easily blew Mable and the others back. As Z2 was about to finish them off, [[Alain]] and his {{TP|Alain|Charizard}} interfered and battled Z2 to buy her and Aliana time. While Z2 was battling, she and Aliana surprised it by shooting it with their laser guns, finally bringing it down and captured it, completing their mission. During Team Flare's attack on [[Lumiose City]], Mable had been ordered to stay at [[Lysandre Labs]]. In ''[[XY133|Coming Apart at the Dreams!]]'', she and Celosia saw a helicopter containing {{an|Serena}}, [[Mairin]], [[Professor Sycamore]], and Team Rocket nearing Lysandre Labs through their security cameras. In [[XY134|the following episode]], Mable tried taking down the helicopter with her Weavile, but she was attacked by {{Steven}} and his {{TP|Steven|Metagross}}. She and several Team Flare Grunts then faced Steven in battle, but were presumably defeated. In ''[[XY135|Rocking Kalos Defenses!]]'', Mable joined Celosia in her battle against Team Rocket. However, the two Scientists were quickly defeated and subdued. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mable |pkmn=Houndoom |type1=Dark |type2=Fire |img=Mable Houndoom.png |epnum=XY094 |epname=From A to Z! |desc={{p|Houndoom}} appeared in ''[[XY094|From A to Z!]]'', during [[Team Flare]]'s attempt to capture [[Z2]] in [[Terminus Cave]]. It, however, was easily defeated by the Order Pokémon's {{m|Land's Wrath}}. Houndoom's only known move is {{m|Flamethrower}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mable |pkmn=Weavile |type1=Dark |type2=Ice |img=Mable Weavile.png |epnum=XY107 |epname=An Explosive Operation! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Weavile}} debuted in ''[[XY107|An Explosive Operation!]]'', where it attacked [[Z2|Zygarde]] alongside [[Aliana]]'s {{p|Druddigon}}. When Z2 transformed to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|10% Forme}}, it was easily beaten back. It was later used twice against {{TRT}} to try to retrieve Z2. While it failed to defeat their Pokémon the first time it succeeded the second time and managed to corner Z2. It, however, was blown back once more when Z2 transformed to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|50% Forme}}. After Z2 was brought down, Weavile and Druddigon were used to blast Team Rocket off. In ''[[XY134|The Right Hero for the Right Job!]]'', Mable used Weavile to attack the helicopter that {{an|Serena}}, Team Rocket, [[Mairin]], and [[Professor Sycamore]] were using to approach [[Lysandre Labs]]. After the arrvial of {{Steven}}, Weavile and several Team Grunt's Pokémon battled [[Steven's Metagross]], but were presumably defeated. Weavile appeared again in [[XY135|the next episode]], where it aided [[Celosia]]'s {{p|Drapion}} in its battle against Team Rocket. After its and Drapion's attacks were countered by [[Jessie's Wobbuffet]]'s {{m|Mirror Coat}}, the two Pokemon and their Trainer's were subdued by Team Rocket's net. Weavile's known moves are {{m|Metal Claw}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, {{m|Icy Wind}}, and {{m|Ice Shard}}.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{fire color light}}|bordercolor={{fire color dark}} |ja=原紗友里 ''[[Sayuri Hara]]'' |en=[[Laurie Hymes]] |fr_eu=Esther Aflalo |pl=Martyna Kowalik |es_la=Annie Rojas |es_eu=Carmen Podio}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Team Flare Scientists Adventures.png|thumb|right|300px|Mable in Pokémon Adventures]] Mable debuted in ''[[PS550|X-actly What They Wanted]]''. She, [[Aliana]], and a group of {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}s traveled to [[Vaniville Town]] to steal {{adv|X}}'s [[Mega Ring]]. While protecting her {{pkmn|Trainer}} from the two scientists, X's [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]] was injured. This angered Kanga's baby, Li'l Kanga, who reacted to the Mega Ring and [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] into Mega Kangaskhan and easily drove the villains off. In ''[[PS551|Inn-teresting Developments]]'', X's friends stayed at an [[Aquacorde Town]] inn while he slept in the tent on {{adv|Y}}'s {{p|Rhyhorn}}'s back. The inn was a trap designed to keep Y and the others inside while Mable and Aliana tried to steal Li'l Kanga when X wasn't looking. Y broke out and informed X of the situation, but when he tried to Mega Evolve Li'l Kanga again, it failed. With no other options, X and Y teamed up with [[Marisso|Chespin]] and [[Croaky|Froakie]] to defeat the scientists. X had Chespin pin Mable and Aliana to a tree with {{m|Pin Missile}}, preventing them from chasing the Vaniville children as they fled to a nearby forest. In ''[[PS555|The Aegislash Agenda]]'', Mable and Aliana met with [[Bryony]] and [[Xerosic]] at the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]]. They were informed that their repeat failures have led to [[Celosia]] taking over their duties. In ''[[PS578|Gyarados Changes]]'', Mable and the other female scientists witnessed X trying to break into the Secret HQ. Noting Celosia hadn't slept since she brought [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] back to base, Mable and Aliana offered to stop X in her place, only for Bryony to tell them to return to their stations. Later, after the [[ultimate weapon]] was stopped by X and his friends, Mable and Aliana helped Bryony up after she was defeated by Y and her newly caught Xerxer. In ''[[PS589|Charizard Transforms]]'', Mable and the other female scientists each intercepted Y and her friends to prevent them from reaching the [[Pokémon Village]]. Mable picked {{adv|Tierno}} as her opponent. Although Mable proved to be powerful, she was defeated when Tierno's {{p|Corphish}} evolved into {{p|Crawdaunt}}, giving it the power to take down Mable and her {{p|Houndoom}} at the same time. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Houndoom 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mable |pkmn=Houndoom |type1=Dark |type2=Fire |gender=female |img=Mable Houndoom Adventures.png |epnum=PS550 |epname=X-actly What They Wanted |desc={{p|Houndoom}} is Mable's only known Pokémon. She was first used to attack {{adv|X}} to steal his [[Mega Ring]]. She attacked {{adv|Y}} when she attempted to protect X, only to be defeated by X's Li'l Kanga after she Mega Evolved into Mega Kangaskhan. At Aquacorde Town, she was used to try and capture X's Li'l Kanga. While X and [[Marisso|Chespin]] fought Aliana and her {{p|Diggersby}}, [[Croaky|Froakie]] fought Houndoom. Later, she was used to fight Tierno's {{p|Corphish}} on the route to Pokémon Village. After Corphish evolved into a {{p|Crawdaunt}}, it defeated both Houndoom and her Trainer with a powerful {{m|Guillotine}}. Houndoom's known moves are {{m|Flamethrower}} and {{m|Inferno}}.}} ==Trivia== * Mable's design for Pokémon X and Y was illustrated by [[Rafał Gosieniecki]].[https://www.instagram.com/p/CHaXIiIHaPY/ Rafał Gosieniecki's Instagram] * In {{g|Legends: Z-A}}, the visor Mable once wore during her time as one of Team Flare's scientists appears on her desk, next to her laptop. * Some aspects of Mable's redesign for Legends: Z-A reference her previous design and past.
